### René Descartes on certainty

René Descartes (1596–1650) approaches certainty within Rationalism. Methodic doubt strips away uncertain beliefs until the cogito—thinking existence—stands firm. Clear and distinct perception, guaranteed by a non-deceiving God, rebuilds knowledge of mind, God, and material nature. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets certainty most directly—useful for searches such as “rené descartes quotes on certainty.”
